# sqlite.work

> > A comprehensive meme documentation platform tracking viral trends, internet culture, and social media phenomena across TikTok, Twitter, Reddit, and other platforms.

The site catalogs and explains internet memes, viral videos, catchphrases, and online trends with detailed guides and collections. It serves as a reference for understanding contemporary digital culture, from exploitable image macros to TikTok dance trends and conspiracy theories.

## Key Topics

- TikTok trends and viral videos
- Exploitable memes and image macros
- Catchphrases and internet slang
- Viral meme explanations
- Social media platforms (Twitter/X, Reddit, Facebook)
- Breaking Bad and pop culture references
- DeviantArt and digital art communities
- Dance memes and music trends
- Conspiracy theories and debunking
- Mental health humor
- Millennial culture and nostalgia
- Looksmaxxing and internet subcultures
- Hood movie references and 90s nostalgia
- YouTube and content creator culture
